title.en: The Prairies and the West Coast up close
title.fr: Les Prairies et la côte Ouest de plus près

text.en: The three Prairie Provinces are Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta.
text.fr: Les trois provinces des Prairies sont le Manitoba, la Saskatchewan et l'Alberta.

source.quote: Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta are the Prairie Provinces

verification.evidence: Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta are the Prairie Provinces

text.en: Winnipeg is the city with the most people in Manitoba. Its Exchange District has Portage and Main, the best-known street corner in Canada.
text.fr: Winnipeg est la ville la plus peuplée du Manitoba. Son quartier de la Bourse comprend Portage et Main, l'intersection la plus connue du Canada.

source.quote: The province’s most populous city is Winnipeg, whose Exchange District includes the most famous street intersection in Canada, Portage and Main.

verification.evidence: Manitoba … The province’s most populous city is Winnipeg, whose Exchange District includes the most famous street intersection in Canada, Portage and Main.

text.en: St. Boniface is Winnipeg's French Quarter. It has the largest Francophone community in Western Canada.
text.fr: Saint-Boniface est le quartier français de Winnipeg. On y trouve la plus grande communauté francophone de l'Ouest canadien.

source.quote: Winnipeg’s French Quarter, St. Boniface, has Western Canada’s largest Francophone community

verification.evidence: Manitoba … Winnipeg’s French Quarter, St. Boniface, has Western Canada’s largest Francophone community

text.en: Ukrainian culture has an important home in Manitoba.
text.fr: La culture ukrainienne a un foyer important au Manitoba.

source.quote: Manitoba is also an important centre of Ukrainian culture

verification.evidence: Manitoba … Manitoba is also an important centre of Ukrainian culture

text.en: Saskatchewan was once called the “breadbasket of the world” and the “wheat province.”
text.fr: La Saskatchewan était autrefois appelée le « grenier du monde » et la « province du blé ».

source.quote: Saskatchewan, once known as the “breadbasket of the world” and the “wheat province,”

verification.evidence: Saskatchewan, once known as the “breadbasket of the world” and the “wheat province,”

text.en: Regina, the capital of Saskatchewan, is where the Royal Canadian Mounted Police has its training academy.
text.fr: C'est à Regina, la capitale de la Saskatchewan, que la Gendarmerie royale du Canada a son école de formation.

source.quote: Regina, the capital, is home to the training academy of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police.

verification.evidence: Saskatchewan … Regina, the capital, is home to the training academy of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police.

text.en: Alberta, and the famous Lake Louise in the Rocky Mountains, both got their names from Princess Louise Caroline Alberta. She was the fourth daughter of Queen Victoria.
text.fr: L'Alberta, ainsi que le célèbre lac Louise dans les Rocheuses, tiennent tous deux leur nom de la princesse Louise Caroline Alberta. Elle était la quatrième fille de la reine Victoria.

source.quote: The province, and the world-famous Lake Louise in the Rocky Mountains, were both named after Princess Louise Caroline Alberta, fourth daughter of Queen Victoria.

verification.evidence: Alberta … The province, and the world-famous Lake Louise in the Rocky Mountains, were both named after Princess Louise Caroline Alberta, fourth daughter of Queen Victoria.

text.en: Alberta has five national parks. One of them is Banff National Park, which was created in 1885.
text.fr: L'Alberta compte cinq parcs nationaux. L'un d'eux est le parc national Banff, créé en 1885.

source.quote: Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885.

verification.evidence: Alberta … Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885.

text.en: Alberta's rough Badlands hold some of the richest beds of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur remains in the world.
text.fr: Les badlands accidentés de l'Alberta renferment certains des plus riches gisements au monde de fossiles préhistoriques et de restes de dinosaures.

source.quote: The rugged Badlands house some of the world’s richest deposits of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds.

verification.evidence: Alberta … The rugged Badlands house some of the world’s richest deposits of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds.

text.en: British Columbia is known for its grand mountains, and as Canada's gateway to the Pacific.
text.fr: La Colombie-Britannique est connue pour ses montagnes majestueuses et comme la porte du Canada sur le Pacifique.

source.quote: British Columbia is known for its majestic mountains and as Canada’s Pacific gateway.

verification.evidence: British Columbia is known for its majestic mountains and as Canada’s Pacific gateway.

text.en: Warm air blowing in from the Pacific Ocean gives the coast of British Columbia a mild climate.
text.fr: L'air chaud qui vient de l'océan Pacifique donne à la côte de la Colombie-Britannique un climat tempéré.

source.quote: Warm airstreams from the Pacific Ocean give the B.C. coast a temperate climate.

verification.evidence: Warm airstreams from the Pacific Ocean give the B.C. coast a temperate climate.

text.en: Victoria, the capital of British Columbia, is a tourist centre. It is also the headquarters of the navy's Pacific fleet.
text.fr: Victoria, la capitale de la Colombie-Britannique, est un centre touristique. C'est aussi le quartier général de la flotte du Pacifique de la marine.

source.quote: The capital, Victoria, is a tourist centre and headquarters of the navy’s Pacific fleet.

verification.evidence: British Columbia … The capital, Victoria, is a tourist centre and headquarters of the navy’s Pacific fleet.
